d.t: WALL EXTENDER FOR EXTENSIVE GREEN ROOF PLANTING TRAY
d.s: SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Extender is a wall extender designed to increase the wall height of an extensive green roof planting tray to increase the soil capacity of each tray. Wall extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and slot into the trays connecting at 90º angles to each wall extender. SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 Wall Extender is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiDrain BG, SikaRoof VersiDrain MEP and SikaRoof VersiDrain 60 trays to increase the soil capacity of these trays enabling more diverse planting options.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Increased planting media capacity for extensive green roofs, landscape decks and lightweight green installations requiring water storage in combination with a suitable geotextile as a filtration layer to prevent planting media from clogging the reservoir and drainage layer.
